title: Restyled Trapdoors
description: A New Look for Wooden Trapdoors
body:
## A New Look for Trapdoors!
This Pack creates a new style for most of the Wooden Trapdoors in the Game, making small changes like giving them more symmetrical features and removing the handles (With the sole exeption of the Spruce Trapdoor, of course).

Here there are some of the main improvements:
- Acacia: Better Pattern
- Bamboo: Finished Pattern
- Birch: Restyle with Birch Log
- Cherry: Restyle with Cherry Leaves
- Crimson: Removed the Straight Lines
- Dark Oak: Removed the Pattern and Smoothened
- Jungle: Better Pattern
- Mangrove: Restyled Pattern
- Oak: Better Pattern
- Pale Oak: Adjusted Some Colors
- Spruce: Adjusted Some Colors
- Warped: Adjusted Some Colors
